Markets.title: US stocks today: Nasdaq rebounds as chip stocks recover from steep losses, rate fears persist
Markets.summary: US stocks rebounded, driven by a 1.73% jump in the Nasdaq as major chipmakers like Nvidia, AMD, Intel, and Micron recovered from previous losses. Meanwhile, stronger-than-expected October jobs data reignited investor concerns regarding a potential December Federal Reserve rate hike.

Markets.title: Stock Market Live Updates: US stocks rebound, but Nasdaq posts fourth straight weekly decline
Markets.summary: US stocks rebounded in the latest trading session. Despite this daily gain, the Nasdaq recorded its fourth consecutive weekly decline.

Markets.title: India's 10-year bond posts best week in 7 years, leads emerging Asia as oil slides
Markets.summary: Indian government bonds achieved their best weekly performance in seven years, outperforming other Asian markets as benchmark yields dropped. The rally was driven by a sharp decline in crude oil prices following the U.S. midterms, which attracted foreign investors and eased pressure on the Reserve Bank of India.

Markets.title: British Airways parent profit drops on higher fuel costs
Markets.summary: British Airways parent IAG reported a more than 12 percent drop in third-quarter net profit. The decline resulted from soaring fuel costs and flight disruptions caused by the Middle East conflict and engine issues.

Markets.title: Trump Media's investors lost $2.2 billion while Trump holds $460 million stake
Markets.summary: Trump Media investors have lost $2.2 billion as the company's stock value has plummeted due to stagnant revenue. Meanwhile, Donald Trump retains a $460 million stake in the struggling social media firm.

Markets.title: Copper price falls for 4th day, heads for worst week since March on AI rout
Markets.summary: Copper prices dropped for the fourth consecutive day, heading toward their worst week since March due to falling technology shares and concerns over artificial intelligence investments. Despite tight global supplies cushioning further losses, the three-month rate on the London Metal Exchange fell to its lowest level since late July.

Geo-Political.title: AI stocks climb after trillions wiped from market values
Geo-Political.summary: Artificial intelligence stocks rose after investors previously sold off tech shares over concerns that a Democratic election victory would slow AI development. This market recovery followed a period where trillions of dollars in value were wiped from the market.

Geo-Political.title: Four midterms takeaways for 2028 White House race
Geo-Political.summary: The 2022 midterm elections revealed early insights and potential momentum for key figures eyeing the 2028 presidential race. Analysts and politicians are already examining these voting patterns to shape future national campaign strategies.

Geo-Political.title: Two dead after bus crashes in France, officials say
Geo-Political.summary: A bus crash in France has resulted in the deaths of one child and one young adult. Several other passengers sustained injuries in the accident, according to local authorities.

Geo-Political.title: New wave of bomb threats hit European airlines
Geo-Political.summary: European airlines have been targeted by a new wave of bomb threats. Investigators have found no connection between these airline threats and recent threats made against media outlets.

Geo-Political.title: Kenyan doomsday cult leader given life sentence for murdering 191 people
Geo-Political.summary: Kenyan doomsday cult leader Paul Mackenzie was sentenced to life in prison for the murder of 191 followers. Mackenzie had ordered his followers to starve their children to death in a forest so they could meet Jesus.

Geo-Political.title: Judge blocks construction of Trump's massive arch after federal agency approval
Geo-Political.summary: A federal judge has blocked the construction of Donald Trump's planned 250-foot arch. The Trump administration had planned for construction to begin as early as this week following federal agency approval.

AI & Tech.title: How I Get Free Traffic from ChatGPT in 2025 (AIO vs SEO)
AI & Tech.summary: The author discovered their SaaS course was recommended as the top result when asking ChatGPT for the best WordPress course. This free AI referral traffic was achieved without paid advertising or traditional search engine optimization techniques.

AI & Tech.title: Top 10 AI Tools That Will Transform Your Content Creation in 2025
AI & Tech.summary: This guide highlights the top 10 AI tools designed to help digital creators level up their content creation in 2025. These essential technologies are revolutionizing the industry and making the content creation process easier.

AI & Tech.title: LimeWire AI Studio Review 2023: Details, Pricing & Features
AI & Tech.summary: LimeWire has launched an AI Studio that functions as a generative tool for content creation. The platform allows creators to generate, share, and monetize their artificial intelligence content.

AI & Tech.title: Top 10 AI Tools in 2023 That Will Make Your Life Easier
AI & Tech.summary: This article explores the top 10 advanced artificial intelligence tools of 2023 that drive industry innovation and efficiency. These widely used applications are designed to automate repetitive tasks, improve workflows, and increase productivity.

AI & Tech.title: Top 10 AI Content Generator & Writer Tools in 2022
AI & Tech.summary: This article lists the top 10 AI content generator and writer tools available in 2022. It explains that these tools help users efficiently create engaging and relevant content for their audiences.

AI & Tech.title: Beginner Guide to CJ Affiliate (Commission Junction) in 2022
AI & Tech.summary: This beginner guide explains how the CJ Affiliate network works and how to earn money on the platform. It also highlights top CJ affiliate programs and alternative platforms.

Data & Insights.title: Bond yield rise squeezes banks' Q2 treasury gains
Data & Insights.summary: Rising bond yields caused public and private banks to report losses on their treasury income during the second quarter. This elevated yield environment may continue to pressure bank earnings through the December quarter.

Data & Insights.title: Internship scheme's new pilot gets more takers post rejig
Data & Insights.summary: About 40,000 candidates have joined the third pilot round of the PM Internship Scheme, which is 2.5 times the turnout of the first two rounds. This positive response has encouraged the corporate affairs ministry to roll out the full programme next year without further pilots.

Data & Insights.title: India gets Strait of Hormuz passage reprieve from Iran. What does Tehran expect in return?
Data & Insights.summary: Iran is allowing Indian ships to pass through the Strait of Hormuz to secure its own supplies of medicines and energy while maintaining diplomatic ties. In return, Tehran expects continued Indian trade and political cooperation amid international isolation.

Data & Insights.title: Food accounts for 53.5% of rural household spending as inflation rises: NABARD survey
Data & Insights.summary: A NABARD survey shows that food accounts for 53.5% of rural household spending amid rising inflation. As prices stay high, rural families are experiencing increased financial strain through depleted savings and higher borrowing.

Data & Insights.title: Mint Primer | How will the blue tsunami in the US mid-terms benefit India?
Data & Insights.summary: The US mid-term election results are expected to lead to a negotiated settlement in the Iran war. This political shift is anticipated to benefit India by curbing former President Trump's aggressive foreign policy instincts.

Data & Insights.title: Snack makers tweak trade margins, engineer pouches to break  ₹5 pack habit
Data & Insights.summary: Rising costs of raw materials like potatoes, edible oil, and packaging are squeezing snack makers' profit margins on cheap entry-level products. To combat this, companies are reducing the size of cheap packs, promoting larger sizes, and expanding their premium product lines.

India.title: Biryani By Kilo, D-Mart Face Action In Maharashtra Crackdown Ahead Of Diwali
India.summary: Maharashtra authorities suspended the licenses of several popular food chains and quick-commerce platforms, including Biryani By Kilo and Zepto, during a pre-Diwali crackdown. The enforcement drive specifically targeted establishments in Mumbai like Blinkit, Tossin Pizza, and Jumbo Burger for various violations.

India.title: Analysis: From Hospital Bed, Sharad Pawar Keeps Maharashtra Guessing Over NCP-NDA Move
India.summary: Sharad Pawar, a veteran and unpredictable politician in India, is currently hospitalized in Maharashtra. From his hospital bed, he has left the public guessing about his political party's potential alliance with the NDA.

India.title: Delhi College Accountant Duped Of Rs 80 Lakh In 'Boss Fraud'
India.summary: An accountant at Delhi's Chanderprabhu Jain College of Higher Studies and School of Law was cheated out of Rs 80 lakh in a "boss fraud" scheme. The educational institution is located in Narela and operated by the Rishi Aurobindo Educational Society.

India.title: Man Confronts Tour Operators About Missing Parents. They Beat Him To Death
India.summary: Haider Ansari was beaten to death by tour operators after confronting them about his parents' delayed return from Umrah in Saudi Arabia. His parents had missed their scheduled October 24 return date.

India.title: Oil Companies Reject Karnataka Minister's '30% Ethanol' Charge Over E20 Petrol, Question Testing Method
India.summary: State-run oil companies have rejected a Karnataka minister's claim that E20 petrol contains 30 percent ethanol. The firms stated that the allegation is unsupported by testing conducted according to official statutory and technical procedures.

India.title: 'E20 Actually Has Over 30% Ethanol': Karnataka Minister Cites Petrol Tests, Demands Consumer Relief Fund
India.summary: Karnataka's Consumer Affairs Minister Rizwan Arshad announced that recent tests of 63 petrol samples across the state revealed ethanol levels reaching up to 31.2 percent, despite being labeled as 20 percent. Following these findings, the minister has demanded the creation of a consumer relief fund.

General.title: Brand's barrister refers himself to regulator after report he confronted journalist
General.summary: Barrister Ian Winter has referred himself to a regulator following allegations that he confronted a journalist outside a court. The reporter had previously investigated the comedian Russell Brand.

General.title: How 2000s lad culture helped Russell Brand to hide in plain sight
General.summary: BBC media editor Katie Razzall writes that the 2000s lad culture environment not only enabled Russell Brand's alleged behavior, but also helped elevate his career. This cultural backdrop ultimately allowed him to hide his actions in plain sight before his prosecution.

General.title: Trump replaces White House chief of staff days after Republicans suffer midterm defeats
General.summary: Following midterm election defeats, President Trump replaced his White House chief of staff. Stephen Miller, the architect of the administration's hard-line immigration policy, will assume the role on Monday.

General.title: New wave of bomb threats hit European airlines
General.summary: A new wave of bomb threats has targeted various European airlines. Authorities have confirmed that these threats are not linked to recent threats made against media outlets.

General.title: Harry and five others seek to challenge Mail publisher privacy ruling
General.summary: Prince Harry and five other public figures lost a High Court privacy case against Associated Newspapers, the publisher of the Daily Mail and Mail on Sunday. The group is now seeking to challenge this ruling.

General.title: Watch: Is it the end of the road for Tesla's Cybertruck?
General.summary: Tesla CEO Elon Musk announced that Cybertruck production in Texas will halt to focus on the company's self-driving Cybercabs. This shift in manufacturing raises questions about the future of the electric pickup truck.
